Zerodha seeks SEBI registration for investment banking venture

Online stock brokerage firm Zerodha is planning to enter the investment banking sector. The company has applied to the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for the necessary registration. This move signifies Zerodha's expansion into a new area of financial services.
